Ultrasound has become an indispensable tool in modern medical diagnosis. This complete guide will help you make the right choice for your practice.

🎯 Ultrasound Machine Selection Criteria

1. The Probe Type

The choice of probe depends directly on the clinical application:

  • Convex probe (3-5 MHz) : Ideal for abdomen and obstetrics
  • Linear probe (7-12 MHz) : Perfect for superficial structures
  • Sector probe (2-4 MHz) : Optimal for cardiology
  • Endocavitary probe : For specialized examinations

2. Image Resolution

Image quality is determined by several factors:

  1. Spatial resolution : Ability to distinguish two close structures
  2. Temporal resolution : Smoothness of real-time image
  3. Contrast resolution : Differentiation of tissues

3. Advanced Features

🎨 Color Doppler

Real-time visualization of blood flows

📊 3D/4D

Volumetric reconstruction for obstetrics

🔬 Elastography

Tissue hardness evaluation

🤖 AI Assisted

Automatic measurements and pathology detection

💰 Budget and Profitability

The investment in an ultrasound machine must be considered in the long term. Here are the elements to consider:

  • Acquisition cost : From €5,000 to €150,000 depending on the range
  • Maintenance : 5-10% of the purchase price per year
  • Training : Essential to optimize use
  • Evolution : Possibility to add probes and software
